title: Waking Up

sound: Low, sustained electronic hum mixed with the sound of fine sand shifting.

title: Finding Life

title: Observing Sky

title: Rescue Arrival
prompt: The rescue ship glides across the upper portion of the frame, its running lights becoming visible. The camera cranes up and back, ending on the astronaut dwarfed by the ship.

title: Canal Discovery
prompt: A small, young child wearing a muted yellow raincoat kneels down and carefully reaches out to pick up the paper boat. The camera holds steady on a locked-off frame, ending on A close-up of the child's hand holding the boat.

title: Gutter Flow

title: Not tonight

dialogue: Not tonight. I am going home.

title: Chef, lip sync
